use_cases.title: Private AI
use_cases.description: Private AI workloads, local model serving, and user-facing AI workbench intent.

use_cases.title: ai-assistant
use_cases.description: Hermes Agent personal assistant with persistent memory and skills on the node's local model, selected with the Private AI assistant module. It inspects and drafts by default; messaging, web search, schedules and external writes are toolsets the owner grants in Hermes. Its dashboard is reached only on a private route behind the kit's login and its own password.

use_cases.title: ai-control-plane
use_cases.description: Paperclip agent control plane (org chart of agents, budgets, approvals, tasks) with its own PostgreSQL in one gVisor-isolated bundle, selected with the Private AI agent-control-plane module. Budgets default to zero and no provider key is configured; the installed Hermes is reachable on the private AI network. Reached only on a private route behind the kit's login and Paperclip's own login.

use_cases.title: ai-documents
use_cases.description: Document text extraction for Open WebUI through Apache Tika, or Docling for scanned and complex layouts, selected with the Private AI document-parsing module. It joins the node's private AI network and has no route of its own.

use_cases.title: ai-harness
use_cases.description: OpenHands task and coding agent whose shell, editor and automations run inside one gVisor-isolated container with its own workspace volume and the node's Ollama as model endpoint, selected with the Private AI agent-harness module. Reached only on a private route behind the kit's login.

use_cases.title: ai-image-video
use_cases.description: ComfyUI image and video generation on the node's CPU or selected GPU with reviewed workflow templates, selected with the Private AI image-video module. ComfyUI has no sign-in of its own, so it is reached only on a private route behind the kit's login.

use_cases.title: ai-search
use_cases.description: Private SearXNG meta search that Open WebUI uses for web search, selected with the Private AI web-search module. It joins the node's private AI network and has no route of its own.

use_cases.title: ai-speech
use_cases.description: kombify SpeechKit server with local speech providers (whisper.cpp STT, Kokoro TTS, the node's Ollama for Assist), selected with the Private AI speech module. It serves OpenAI-compatible audio routes to the chat module on the node's private AI network behind its bearer token and has no route of its own.

use_cases.title: basement-core
use_cases.description: Required standalone Basement control plane with local routing, owner identity, internal PKI, container management, and operator hub.

use_cases.title: Developer Platform
use_cases.description: Private source control, developer collaboration, and delivery-platform intent.

use_cases.title: Documents
use_cases.description: Private document ingestion, OCR, indexing and search through Paperless-ngx.

use_cases.title: File Storage and Documents
use_cases.description: Private file storage and sharing: Cloudreve by default, Nextcloud or kombify Paperwork as alternatives, with optional office editing and a document archive.

use_cases.title: files-office
use_cases.description: Euro-Office Document Server for browser editing of documents, spreadsheets and presentations, selected in addition to the files workload and connected to Nextcloud through the eurooffice-nextcloud app.

use_cases.title: Game Server
use_cases.description: Self-hosted game servers for friends and family through Pterodactyl, with curated Minecraft Java, Paper and Bedrock, Terraria and Valheim profiles.

use_cases.title: Private Mail
use_cases.description: Private webmail through Roundcube for a mailbox you already have at an external provider. No mail server, DNS or MX record is created.

use_cases.title: Media Library
use_cases.description: Private media library and streaming intent for household media collections.

use_cases.title: media-audiobooks
use_cases.description: Audiobooks and podcasts through Audiobookshelf from the owner-custodied media library, selected in addition to the media workload.

use_cases.title: media-music
use_cases.description: Music streaming through Navidrome from the owner-custodied media library, selected in addition to the media workload.

use_cases.title: Photos and Memories
use_cases.description: Family photo and video vault with mobile backup, search, and shared memories.

use_cases.title: photos-kiosk

use_cases.title: photos-share

use_cases.title: photos-tools

use_cases.title: Private AI
use_cases.description: Private AI workloads, local model serving, and user-facing AI workbench intent.

use_cases.title: ai-assistant
use_cases.description: Hermes Agent personal assistant with persistent memory and skills on the node's local model, selected with the Private AI assistant module. It inspects and drafts by default; messaging, web search, schedules and external writes are toolsets the owner grants in Hermes. Its dashboard is reached only on a private route behind the kit's login and its own password.

use_cases.title: ai-control-plane
use_cases.description: Paperclip agent control plane (org chart of agents, budgets, approvals, tasks) with its own PostgreSQL in one gVisor-isolated bundle, selected with the Private AI agent-control-plane module. Budgets default to zero and no provider key is configured; the installed Hermes is reachable on the private AI network. Reached only on a private route behind the kit's login and Paperclip's own login.

use_cases.title: ai-documents
use_cases.description: Document text extraction for Open WebUI through Apache Tika, or Docling for scanned and complex layouts, selected with the Private AI document-parsing module. It joins the node's private AI network and has no route of its own.

use_cases.title: ai-harness
use_cases.description: OpenHands task and coding agent whose shell, editor and automations run inside one gVisor-isolated container with its own workspace volume and the node's Ollama as model endpoint, selected with the Private AI agent-harness module. Reached only on a private route behind the kit's login.

use_cases.title: ai-image-video
use_cases.description: ComfyUI image and video generation on the node's CPU or selected GPU with reviewed workflow templates, selected with the Private AI image-video module. ComfyUI has no sign-in of its own, so it is reached only on a private route behind the kit's login.

use_cases.title: ai-search
use_cases.description: Private SearXNG meta search that Open WebUI uses for web search, selected with the Private AI web-search module. It joins the node's private AI network and has no route of its own.

use_cases.title: ai-speech
use_cases.description: kombify SpeechKit server with local speech providers (whisper.cpp STT, Kokoro TTS, the node's Ollama for Assist), selected with the Private AI speech module. It serves OpenAI-compatible audio routes to the chat module on the node's private AI network behind its bearer token and has no route of its own.

use_cases.title: cloud-core
use_cases.description: Required provider-neutral Cloud control plane installed on an externally supplied host; provider and server lifecycle remain outside StackKits.

use_cases.title: Developer Platform
use_cases.description: Private source control, developer collaboration, and delivery-platform intent.

use_cases.title: Documents
use_cases.description: Private document ingestion, OCR, indexing and search through Paperless-ngx.

use_cases.title: File Storage and Documents
use_cases.description: Private file storage and sharing: Cloudreve by default, Nextcloud or kombify Paperwork as alternatives, with optional office editing and a document archive.

use_cases.title: files-office
use_cases.description: Euro-Office Document Server for browser editing of documents, spreadsheets and presentations, selected in addition to the files workload and connected to Nextcloud through the eurooffice-nextcloud app.

use_cases.title: Game Server
use_cases.description: Self-hosted game servers for friends and family through Pterodactyl, with curated Minecraft Java, Paper and Bedrock, Terraria and Valheim profiles.

use_cases.title: Private Mail
use_cases.description: Private webmail through Roundcube for a mailbox you already have at an external provider. No mail server, DNS or MX record is created.

use_cases.title: Own Mail Server
use_cases.description: Your own mail server on a dedicated Cloud node through Stalwart: mailboxes for your domain with SMTP, IMAP and submission. StackKits prints the DNS records you publish; it never changes DNS.

use_cases.title: Media Library
use_cases.description: Private media library and streaming intent for household media collections.

use_cases.title: media-audiobooks
use_cases.description: Audiobooks and podcasts through Audiobookshelf from the owner-custodied media library, selected in addition to the media workload.

use_cases.title: media-music
use_cases.description: Music streaming through Navidrome from the owner-custodied media library, selected in addition to the media workload.

use_cases.title: Private AI
use_cases.description: Private AI workloads, local model serving, and user-facing AI workbench intent.

use_cases.title: ai-assistant
use_cases.description: Hermes Agent personal assistant with persistent memory and skills on the node's local model, selected with the Private AI assistant module. It inspects and drafts by default; messaging, web search, schedules and external writes are toolsets the owner grants in Hermes. Its dashboard is reached only on a private route behind the kit's login and its own password.

use_cases.title: ai-control-plane
use_cases.description: Paperclip agent control plane (org chart of agents, budgets, approvals, tasks) with its own PostgreSQL in one gVisor-isolated bundle, selected with the Private AI agent-control-plane module. Budgets default to zero and no provider key is configured; the installed Hermes is reachable on the private AI network. Reached only on a private route behind the kit's login and Paperclip's own login.

use_cases.title: ai-documents
use_cases.description: Document text extraction for Open WebUI through Apache Tika, or Docling for scanned and complex layouts, selected with the Private AI document-parsing module. It joins the node's private AI network and has no route of its own.

use_cases.title: ai-harness
use_cases.description: OpenHands task and coding agent whose shell, editor and automations run inside one gVisor-isolated container with its own workspace volume and the node's Ollama as model endpoint, selected with the Private AI agent-harness module. Reached only on a private route behind the kit's login.

use_cases.title: ai-image-video
use_cases.description: ComfyUI image and video generation on the node's CPU or selected GPU with reviewed workflow templates, selected with the Private AI image-video module. ComfyUI has no sign-in of its own, so it is reached only on a private route behind the kit's login.

use_cases.title: ai-search
use_cases.description: Private SearXNG meta search that Open WebUI uses for web search, selected with the Private AI web-search module. It joins the node's private AI network and has no route of its own.

use_cases.title: ai-speech
use_cases.description: kombify SpeechKit server with local speech providers (whisper.cpp STT, Kokoro TTS, the node's Ollama for Assist), selected with the Private AI speech module. It serves OpenAI-compatible audio routes to the chat module on the node's private AI network behind its bearer token and has no route of its own.

use_cases.title: basement-core
use_cases.description: Required standalone Basement control plane with local routing, owner identity, internal PKI, container management, and operator hub.

use_cases.description: Private source control, developer collaboration, and delivery-platform intent.
